 Ask│  Quick trade-off summary:                                                                │    
    │  - PostgreSQL: strongest for relational integrity, complex queries, concurrent writes;   │    
 Evi│    standard production default.                                                          │    
 fil│  - SQLite: zero-config, single-file, great for local tools/prototypes/small datasets;    │    
 fil│    weak for concurrent writers.                                                          │    
    │ ↓  - MySQL/MariaDB: battle-tested relational option; common in Perl/legacy stacks.       │
